sections.notes: Shared Footer component instance (124:3298), byte-identical on all three frames. Dark background. The developer strapline originally claimed open source, self-hostable and API-first; Zach confirmed the first two (public, Apache-2.0) and dropped API-first, which is a term of art for an API-primary product. See claimsToVerify for the original wording.

claimsToVerify.phrase: See what visitors browse on and where they come from — device split and top referrers.
claimsToVerify.why: Uses a VISITORS metric. Aglyn measures page/screen views, not unique visitors. Banned-claim list: 'conversions/visitors metrics'.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Find where each screen’s visitors are coming from.
claimsToVerify.why: Second VISITORS reference. Same concern as above.

claimsToVerify.phrase: See what’s working on every site you run.
claimsToVerify.why: Reads as a cross-site analytics rollup, which Aglyn does not have. Needs rewording to per-site if the console has no aggregate view.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Page views, top pages, referrers, and device split for every site — with per-screen trends and commerce revenue built in.
claimsToVerify.why: 'for every site' again implies a cross-site rollup.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Page views, top pages, and referrers for every site — collected cookielessly.
claimsToVerify.why: Third 'for every site' cross-site rollup implication.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Track page views, top pages, referrers, and device split for every site you run.
claimsToVerify.why: Fourth 'for every site' cross-site rollup implication.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Free to start — see traffic on every site from day one.
claimsToVerify.why: Fifth 'every site' cross-site rollup implication, and it promises the metric on the free tier — but the Capabilities grid gates per-screen analytics at 'Pro & up'. Verify what Free actually gets.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Drill into any screen’s 14-day traffic, device split, and referrers (Pro & up).
claimsToVerify.why: Plan gate 'Pro & up' — confirm per-screen analytics really starts at Pro and not Starter.

claimsToVerify.phrase: See impressions and clicks on your announcement bars and popups.
claimsToVerify.why: Overlay impression/click metrics — cross-check that these are actually recorded, since the Marketing page makes the same promise.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Revenue, orders, average order value, and top products from your store.
claimsToVerify.why: 'top products' is the one item here not evidenced anywhere else in the design. Verify the metric exists.
An average-time-on-screen metric appears in the MOCKUP but in none of the copy. If Aglyn does not compute dwell time, the illustration is claiming a metric that doesn't exist.
Period-over-period comparison deltas. Verify the product actually shows a comparison figure.

The Product overview page's heading says 'Eight products, one platform.' while showing nine cards, and this page's Explore grid shows only seven. Three different counts across the same design. Pick one.
SELF-HOSTING CLAIM. Only 'Docker + your own Firebase project' is supportable; 'self-hostable' unqualified plus 'Open source' overstates it. Appears on all three pages.
